blocks.text: PALO, Leyte — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. called on Filipinos to protect the country’s sovereignty and turn wartime heroes’ sacrifices into concrete improvements in people’s lives, as the country marked the 82nd anniversary of the Leyte Gulf Landings on Tuesday. “Freedom must be felt in our everyday lives through food security, stable employment, safe communities, and responsive governance,” Marcos said in a message delivered by Cabinet Secretary Benhur Abalos, who represented him during the commemorative rites at the MacArthur Landing Memorial National Park in Candahug village here.
